title: Targeting Angiogenesis in Drug Discovery: Current Status and Future Directions.
snippet: Angiogenesis, the formation of new blood vessels from pre-existing vasculature, is essential for development, tissue repair, and reproduction; however, dysregulation of angiogenesis contributes to cancer, ocular disorders, chronic inflammation, and cardiovascular diseases.
